description: Confirm-gated create POST body and the unsupported-argument rejection now enforced in both languages (Go gained Python's allowlist). The unsupported case sets confirm:true so both reach the check. The bare-array case proves neither language reports a zero-valued instance as a successful create; its expected substring stops at 'Failed to create' because the engine label differs in the outer framing (Go says 'Managed Database instance', Python says 'MySQL Managed Database').

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This creates a billable Managed Database instance. Set confirm=true to proceed.
